name: Structure and function
subject: Science
scope_note: NGSS states this dimension across all of K-12, with grade-band elaborations of what it looks like at each level. Modelled once here; the band elaborations attach after the standards are ingested.

rights.rights_holder: NGSS Lead States (developed via Achieve); trademark transferred from Achieve to WestEd in May 2020; the published standards volume is copyright National Academies Press
rights.gate_meaning: The licence does not clearly cover this repository's intended use (for-profit / commercial product). Indexing and internal analysis are fine; an owner decision is required before framework content ships to students.
rights.attribution_notice: NGSS Lead States. 2013. Next Generation Science Standards: For States, By States. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
rights.trademark_gate: Separate and firm regardless of the commercial question: the product must not put 'NGSS' or 'Next Generation Science Standards' in a product/feature title, must not use the logo, and must not imply WestEd endorsement. Describing content as 'aligned to the NGSS' in body text is nominative use and is the intended pattern.

elaborations_status.reason: Band-by-band elaborations come from the NGSS appendices (Appendix F for practices, Appendix G for crosscutting concepts) - fetch required.
elaborations_status.rule: An empty list here means 'not yet transcribed from the official source', never 'the framework has none'. Consumers must treat a pending layer as absent rather than as an empty curriculum.

importance.exam_weight_note: NGSS sets no papers. State science assessments built on NGSS are separate programmes with separate rights.
